desc: Sort cakes by each of the three coordinates (descending) and compute edge prices for adjacent pairs.
Implement a max-heap greedy selection of K non-overlapping edges on a path.
Verify the greedy selection is correct (exchange argument) or replace with a correct O(N) DP for path matching.
Verify that considering only adjacent pairs in the three sorts is sufficient for the original problem (e.g., test with random small N brute force over all matchings vs three-sorted adjacent pairs).
Test the solution on provided samples and additional edge cases (including K=1, large N, identical values).
Ensure overall time complexity is O(N log N) or O(N) per test case and fits within limits.
